panels.title: Copy: remove last 'Get her Instagram' strings
panels.scene: Knight with a large chisel chipping away giant creepy floating stone letters above the village square that spell out 'GET HER INSTAGRAM'. Villagers weeping tears of joy, throwing carrier pigeons into the air.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: The dark wizard's creepy scroll request is gone forever!

bubbles.speaker: Knight
bubbles.text: I just deleted a text string from the preview page.

panels.title: Copy: drop conquest framing from scores and scenarios
panels.scene: A gigantic wooden scoreboard in the kingdom center. The old header 'BLOODTHIRSTY CONQUEST SCORE' is painted over with 'Friendly Conversation Points'. Knights in heavy armor are dropping their axes and weeping.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: We can get a high score without invading a entire kingdom?!

bubbles.speaker: Knight
bubbles.text: I changed the text labels in two files.

panels.title: Copy: remove conquest framing from paths
panels.scene: A dirt road fork with a stone signpost. The top sign 'PATH OF TOTAL DOMINION' is crossed out with red paint and replaced with 'Path A'. A knight in full plate armor is kneeling and hugging a tiny flower.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: The road no longer demands blood! We may walk in peace!

bubbles.speaker: Knight
bubbles.text: It is literally just a path name.

panels.title: 2 commits. 0 conquests. 100% peace.
panels.scene: Knight slumped over exhausted at a tavern table with a cup of water. In the background, villagers are carving a giant marble statue of a knight holding an edit pencil.
